_about: Curated HuggingFace training data for the from-scratch elashry-ai code agent. Every dataset is mapped to a concrete agent feature (chat / agent-mode / explain / fix / refactor). DATA downloads only — no pretrained weights, no runtime API. Verified working on `datasets==5.0.0` (parquet + ungated, run with zero setup). Verified 2026-07-25.
_datasets_v5_note: datasets>=4 dropped script-based datasets and `trust_remote_code`. Several classic corpora (the-stack, codeparrot/github-code-clean, bigcode/commitpackft, nampdn-ai/tiny-codes) are now either GATED (need a free HF login + accept terms) or script-based (dead). The set below avoids all of that. Gated alternatives are listed under `gated_optional` if you later set an HF token.

_agent_features.chat_workspace: Chat panel that answers about code with workspace context.
_agent_features.agent_mode: One command -> full task (read/edit files, run commands) in an autonomous loop.

prompt_format._why: Train the model on ONE consistent I/O template so it speaks the agent's protocol. Add these as reserved special tokens in the BPE tokenizer (they count toward vocab_size in arch_presets.json).
prompt_format.notes: TinyStories is trained raw (no template) as a coherence warm-up. Everything else is wrapped in the instruction_template by data_common.format_example().

curriculum.name: coherence_bootstrap
curriculum.why: A from-scratch nano model must first learn to emit fluent tokens before it can imitate code well.

curriculum.name: code_fundamentals
curriculum.why: Bulk instruction->code (Python-heavy). Teaches syntax, idioms, and command->code mapping. Backbone of chat_workspace + agent_mode.

curriculum.name: task_shaping
curriculum.why: Multi-language instructions + edits + explanations mapped onto the agent protocol. This is what makes it behave like OUR agent.

curriculum.name: cybersecurity
curriculum.why: Defensive security domain data (OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, crypto, cloud/devsecops). User's second focus area alongside programming.
curriculum._removed: hcnote/Cybersecurity-High-Quality-Dataset — أُزيل 2026-07-27: صيني كتير كان بيتسرّب في إجابات الأمن (bilingual). الفورماتر لسه موجود في data_common لو حبيت ترجّعه.

curriculum.name: arabic
curriculum.why: User wants the model to handle Arabic too (his language). General Arabic (Wikipedia) for language coherence + Arabic instructions. Requires an Arabic-aware tokenizer (vocab bumped to 16384).

curriculum.name: evaluation
curriculum.why: Measure code-gen quality. NEVER train on these — held out only.

roneneldan/TinyStories.map_to_agent: Not code — bootstraps coherent generation in a tiny model (TinyStories paper). Streamed.

jtatman/python-code-dataset-500k.map_to_agent: instruction -> output = the main command->code backbone (Python). output holds lots of raw code the model learns from.

iamtarun/python_code_instructions_18k_al.map_to_agent: Clean alpaca-style instruction(+input) -> output. Small, high-signal command->code.

sahil2801/CodeAlpaca-20k.map_to_agent: instruction(+input) -> output maps directly onto <|task|>/<|context|>/<|response|>. Multi-language command->code.

m-a-p/CodeFeedback-Filtered-Instruction.map_to_agent: query -> answer, filtered/high-quality, MANY languages. Broadens the agent beyond Python. Filter by lang with --languages.

bigcode/self-oss-instruct-sc2-exec-filte.map_to_agent: instruction -> response, execution-VALIDATED solutions (higher correctness signal than raw scrapes).

Maxscha/commitbench.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (data) — non-commercial; fine for this personal project
Maxscha/commitbench.map_to_agent: commit `message` = instruction, `diff` = the change. Teaches the fix/refactor code-actions and agent-mode edits (intent -> diff).

code-search-net/code_search_net.map_to_agent: func_code_string -> func_documentation_string = the explain code-action (code in <|context|>, explanation in <|response|>). First shard is slow to stream (~60s).

openai/openai_humaneval.map_to_agent: Held-out pass@k benchmark. NEVER train on it.

google-research-datasets/mbpp.map_to_agent: 974 basic Python problems with tests. Second held-out benchmark. NEVER train on it.

gated_optional._note: These are the originally-desired corpora. On datasets v5 they need a FREE HuggingFace account: accept the terms on the dataset page, then `huggingface-cli login` (or set HF_TOKEN). No payment. Add them to the curriculum + a formatter in data_common.py if you opt in.
gated_optional.bigcode/the-stack-smol: Small sample of The Stack — real raw code files across languages. GATED.
gated_optional.bigcode/starcoderdata: Large raw code pretraining corpus. GATED.
